title: LotlxBox Resource Pack
description: The Official Resource Pack for LotlxBox
body:
**LotlxBox** – Official Resource Pack

This is the **official** resource pack for the LotlxBox Minecraft Box Server.

Currently included server-specific textured items:

- Over-Kill Mace

- Soul Sand Mace

- Pumpkin Mace

- Candycane Pickaxe & Sword

- Piglin Blacksmith Hammer

- Overworld Tyrant Voucher

- Overworld Auto Compressor

This resource pack is **recommended** for players on LotlxBox to see these items correctly and experience the server as **intended**.

⚠️ Important: This resource pack is **not** intended for vanilla or survival gameplay and may not function correctly outside the **LotlxBox** server.

Server IP: LotlxBox.minehut.gg

Join our community on [Discord](https://dsc.gg/lotlxb) for updates, events and more!
